narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with MRSA source bed rail A. Transfer chain: bed rail A → gloved hand at 22 seconds → call button at 26.3 seconds. Glove don at 22 seconds and 54.8 seconds, doff at 32.3 seconds and 63.6 seconds; no glove use issues identified. No resident exposures; resident A contact at 55.2, 63.6 seconds occurred after hygiene and with appropriate glove use. Contaminated at end: bed rail A (source) and call button (2 contaminated contacts). Disinfect call button and bed rail A with an EPA List H registered disinfectant effective against MRSA.
